title: contractor-injury-claims: U.S. Defense Base Act claims by country, FY2009-FY2024
description:
Claims filed under the U.S. Defense Base Act, which covers civilian contractors injured or killed while working on U.S. government contracts overseas, by country and U.S. fiscal year (FY2009-FY2024), with the U.S. Department of Labor's cumulative table for 2001-2024. Case types: no lost time, lost time of 3 days or less, lost time of 4 days or more, death, salary continuation and other. The numbers are new cases opened by the Labor Department, not official casualty counts; the country is where the injury happened; small numbers suppressed in the source are left blank. Includes the source tables, cleaning and checking code, and documentation.

Dataset: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT. The source tables are U.S. government works.
